2589|### 2026-10-17 · Claude Opus 5.5 — bridge-bootstrap-20261017 · handed off (owner switching to pi)
2590|
2591|Owner direction: get op-grpc-bridge built, installed and coming up after a reboot first; nothing else comes up until it does. Then the single socket (lungs.sock), network docs, commit and push. Owner is sole developer and has seen the tun5/lungs design working. **There is no GRE.** The 2026-10-03 "GRE retained" claims are stale.
2592|
2593|**Build:** detached `cargo build --workspace --release` (pid 24043, own session, reparented to PID 1) was compiling dependencies at handoff. Log: `/tmp/claude-1000/-srv-git-odbus-verified/21395764-6c41-441c-a0c1-16efb2466698/scratchpad/build-workspace.log` (under /tmp; lost on reboot). Artifacts land in `target/release` (= /var/lib/cargo-build/odbus-verified). Not yet built: `crates/op-uds-relay` (outside workspace: `cargo build --release --manifest-path crates/op-uds-relay/Cargo.toml`) and threetched (`vendor/tched-router/build-threetched.sh`). Note the 2026-10-16 GLM build receipt is not a clean tree build; do not deploy it.
2594|
2595|**Boot chain for the bridge (from deploy/runit run files):** opdbus-rundirs (needs /usr/local/bin/opblob + persisted sealed catalog; `opblob stage-shm`) → uplink-dhcp → ovsdb-server → ovs-vswitchd (op-ovsbr0-setup) → ovsbr0-cutover; bridge also waits on opdbus-grants, dbus, unified-execution, op-runit-systemctl, op-session-bus, identity-roots (incusd), op-warp-ssh-host, op-warp-ssh-routes, tched-router, plus 10.0.0.2 on rtly-lungs and 10.0.0.3 on ovsbr0. No dependency cycles back to the bridge. Order: build → `sudo env COGNITIVE_MCP_QDRANT_URL=… target/release/opblob seal-shm` + `persist` → activate-golden.sh → enable services → rtly-lungs transport (deploy/decoy-warp-ssh, host side: endpoint.sh, admission.sh, routing.sh, warp-ssh-sshd.conf from ssh-host.conf.example, warp-link user exists, authorized key must come from decoy /var/lib/op-warp-ssh/client_ed25519.pub) → bridge → reboot test.
2596|
2597|**BLOCKER needing owner decision (storage; owner said do not touch storage/LVM):** `op-release` (source /srv/git/odbus-btrfs-enforcement-20261013/crates/op-storage/src/bin/op-release.rs) hard-codes `HOST_FS = 083161be`, the wiped old system fs. It requires /opt/op-dbus/golden to be a subvolume on it; golden is now a plain directory inside @opt on d53eeac0. So activate-golden.sh → op-release-launch release will fail. `op-release-launch status` works (guard READY, both slots empty). Same cause: op-storage crash-loops "host source does not match pinned layout"; storage-policy.json pins logs/cargo-build/opt/golden/git/vectors to 083161be (now @logs 269, @opt 271, @git 273 on d53eeac0; cargo-build a18aafa3; vectors 6a20c81c). Proposed fix (not done): HOST_FS→d53eeac0, rebuild/install op-release+op-storage with manifest update, create golden subvolume from the trusted release cgroup, re-pin policy.
2598|
2599|**Seed (/run/mount/3tched-seed/@):** 3tchedfs.service installed+enabled, matches deploy/workspace-image; preflight matches repo. Preflight fails until these exist: /usr/share/op-dbus/lungs-catalog/.manifest.json, lungs-view/objects, lungs-empty-state (need sealed catalog + capture), plus runtime /run/3tched-lungs.socket. Seed fs ~1.5 GiB free; SEEDING flag not set.
2600|

{"content":"1|//! Adapter for the pinned downstream Btrfs quiescent-destroy ABI.
2|//! No userspace scan, kernel-version guess, or ordinary-delete fallback is safe.
3|use std::{io, os::fd::{AsRawFd, BorrowedFd}};
4|use uuid::Uuid;
5|
6|// deploy/release/lifetime/0001-btrfs-quiescent-destroy.patch, native Linux ABI:
7|// _IOW(BTRFS_IOCTL_MAGIC /* 0x94 */, 255, struct ... /* 96 bytes */).
8|const SNAP_DESTROY_QUIESCENT: libc::c_ulong = 0x4060_94ff;
9|
10|#[repr(C)]
11|struct QuiescentDestroy {
12|    subvolid: u64,
13|    fsid: [u8; 16],
14|    uuid: [u8; 16],
15|    received_uuid: [u8; 16],
16|    flags: u64,
17|    reserved: [u64; 4],
18|}
19|const _: () = assert!(std::mem::size_of::<QuiescentDestroy>() == 96);
20|
21|// The caller journals exact identity before this call and must close its own
22|// target-root descriptors/mounts first. `top` is a different root on the same
23|// filesystem. Source snapshots and aborted incoming roots use this same path;
24|// they must be read-only too (a zero received UUID is valid).
25|//
26|// The kernel holds admission closed continuously from its reference census
27|// through unlink. Success permanently closes the old incarnation; no userspace
28|// lease/Drop unlock is needed while the caller waits for the cleaner and renames
29|// the incoming root. Live-alias rejection precedes root unlink. Other failures
30|// can follow unlink, so recovery must reconcile identity after every error.
31|// The ABI reserves EBUSY/ESTALE/EROFS/EINVAL for pre-unlink rejection and maps
32|// all failures after root unlink starts to EIO. EIO never promises rollback.
33|// ENOENT is special to this checked ABI: its kernel lifetime registry includes
34|// orphan root objects through final free and proves the exact generation has
35|// no live inode aliases. Pathname absence or native cleaner completion alone
36|// never substitutes for that proof. A busy orphan remains admission-closed.
37|// ENOTTY means the required kernel is absent and must remain a hard failure.
38|pub fn destroy(
39|    top: BorrowedFd<'_>,
40|    fsid: Uuid,
41|    subvolid: u64,
42|    native_uuid: Uuid,
43|    received_uuid: Uuid,
44|) -> io::Result<()> {
45|    let args = QuiescentDestroy {
46|        subvolid,
47|        fsid: fsid.into_bytes(),
48|        uuid: native_uuid.into_bytes(),
49|        received_uuid: received_uuid.into_bytes(),
50|        flags: 0,
51|        reserved: [0; 4],
52|    };
53|    // SAFETY: the fixed-layout, fully initialized 96-byte input and borrowed
54|    // ioctl-capable directory descriptor remain valid throughout the syscall.
55|    let result = unsafe { libc::ioctl(top.as_raw_fd(), SNAP_DESTROY_QUIESCENT, &args) };
56|    match result {
57|        0 => Ok(()),
58|        -1 => Err(io::Error::last_os_error()),
59|        _ => Err(io::Error::from_raw_os_error(libc::EPROTO)),
60|    }
